method.bootstrap: 10000 paired task draws with replacement within each repo, retaining stratum sizes; overall ratio of sums across resampled repos; seed 20260907 reset per metric/summary; linear percentile 95% interval
method.tokens: normalized input + cache read + cache creation + output; cache counted once
method.timing: tool timings measure JSONL reception; union per run, then summed; missing endpoints excluded; no inference of model-only time
method.manifest: manifestFileSha256 hashes supplied bytes; manifestSha256 is the runner stable-JSON hash copied from evidence, not recomputed
method.scope: completed pairs including failures; unpaired runs and superseded infrastructure excluded; original gate unchanged
